referenceStatus: Fresh text-only generations, no edit or image references.
processing: Sharp Lanczos3 resize to 128x128, WebP quality 90, effort 6. Each review image shows the resized candidate at 32px and 48px, enlarged to 192px by nearest-neighbor sampling.

review.assessment: Generator and independent static review passed at 32 and 48 pixels. Real-game review remains pending.

limitations: Experimental pilot only; gameplay, visual consistency and release rights review pending. Hashes identify bytes, not rights.

records.prompt: Create one original square target portrait for a stylized fantasy game: a dark gray forest wolf with broad muzzle, compact chunky proportions and triangular ears, head and shoulders against a simple dark woodland background. Its mouth is closed, brows subtly lowered and eyes focused, conveying alert, stern hostility without snarling, gore or exaggerated menace. Hand-painted illustration with simplified rounded shapes, soft brush texture and restrained detail; playful low-poly fantasy game sensibility. Clear silhouette and face at 32 and 48 pixels. Opaque full-bleed image; no text, lettering, border, logo, watermark, copied game design or image references.
records.sourceVerification: Generated source bytes matched the copied master at packaging time.
